articles.title: PDP crisis caused by misinterpretation of Supreme Court  judgement — Party chieftain

critical_questions: What specific Supreme Court rulings were allegedly misinterpreted, and by whom exactly within the party?

articles.title: Press Freedom Day 2026: Southwest NUJ calls for safety, AI accountability
articles.summary: Samo reaffirmed the Union’s commitment to training members on conflict-sensitive reporting, engage lawmakers on stronger protections, and partner with civil society to expand access to public information.
articles.hausa_translation: Ranar Sassauran Labarai 2026: Southwest NUJ ke kira ga Kariya, Halin Lalacewa na AI - Samo ya sake imani ga Taƙaitaccen Gida na Jama'a game da horon membobi akan raportage mai hankali ga rikici, kula da lawaye don ingantaccen kariya, da haɗa kai tare da jama'ar al'umma don faɗawar samun bayani na jama'a.
critical_questions: What specific AI-related threats to press freedom prompted this year's focus, and has the Southwest NUJ documented concrete incidents?
Who exactly is Samo, what authority does he/she hold in NUJ, and are these commitments backed by measurable timelines and budgets?
Which lawmakers have been engaged, and what is their track record on passing or implementing stronger press protection laws?
Which civil society organizations are mentioned as partners, and do they have independent editorial oversight or funding relationships with media houses?

articles.title: Man kills influencer wife, dies by suicide
articles.summary: A 52-year-old man identified as Subramanian allegedly hacked his 42-year-old wife Nagalakshmi, an Instagram influencer with over 300,000 followers, to death before dying by suicide at their residence in Nanganallur, Chennai, India.
articles.hausa_translation: Wata mutum ya kashe jaridar Instagram mai karɓa Subramanian da jaridarsa Nagalakshmi, wanda ke da masu biyu sama da ɗari dubu akan Instagram, a gida nsu a Nanganallur, Chennai, India, sannan ya kashe kansa.
critical_questions: What evidence confirms this was a murder-suicide rather than alternative explanations, and who verified the findings?
What documented history of domestic conflict existed between the couple, and did authorities receive prior reports?
Why is the wife's influencer status emphasized in the headline—does this detail serve journalistic purpose or sensationalism?
What access did Subramanian have to weapons, and were there mental health indicators or warnings before the incident?
How were the circumstances of his death determined, and is there independent verification of the suicide claim?

articles.title: 2027: Enugu North zone pledges 100% votes for Tinubu, Mbah

articles.title: Sri Lanka hikes fuel prices as inflation spikes
articles.summary: Since March, Sri Lanka has raised fuel prices by more than 35 per cent, while gas and electricity rates have also increased by a similar amount.
articles.hausa_translation: Sri Lanka ta dagawa farashin mai da saura kayan mai sauyi. Tun waje ga waje, Sri Lanka ta dagawa farashin mai sama da kashi 35 cikin 100, kuma farashin iskar lantarki da gas kuma sun dagawa da kashi da saukin. Wannan ya haifar da karin hauhawar farashin kayan aiki a gida.
critical_questions: What triggered Sri Lanka's fiscal crisis and debt situation that necessitated these price hikes?
Who benefits from these fuel price increases - are there specific industries or entities profiting while ordinary citizens bear the burden?
What alternative measures or revenue sources were considered before imposing these increases, and why were they rejected?
How are vulnerable populations (low-income households, essential workers) being supported or protected during this transition?
Is Sri Lanka's government being pressured by international creditors (IMF, World Bank) to implement these measures, and what are the broader structural conditions?

articles.title: Speaker Abbas Commissions 100-bed Renewed Hope Hospital In Zaria
articles.summary: The Speaker of the House of Representatives, Hon. Abbas Tajudeen, on Saturday commissioned a 100-bed Renewed Hope Specialist Hospital in his Zaria Federal Constituency.   The 100-bed specialist hospital, located at the Dumbin Rauga community under the Dutsen Abba Ward, was facilitated by the Speaker under the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) office.   A statement […]
articles.hausa_translation: Magajin Majlis Wakilan Kasar, Hon. Abbas Tajudeen, ya ba da izini gida mai cutar 100-gida a Zaria na sa kansa. Asibiti mai kwarewa 100-gida, wanda ke gefen Dumbin Rauga a cikin Dutsen Abba, an saumarwa shi ta gefen Magajin Majlis a ƙarƙashin Ofishin Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Sanarwa ta nuna cewa asibiti na saida jihadun tayarwa a yankin.
critical_questions: Who owns and will operate this hospital - is it government-run, private, or NGO-managed, and what are the implications for sustainability and access?
What is the actual cost of the facility and how was it funded - were public funds used, and if so, how does this align with budget allocations?
What evidence exists that this facility is operational and functional versus simply commissioned for symbolic/political purposes?
Why was this specific community selected over other underserved areas, and were there transparent criteria for project selection?
Who provided the medical staff, equipment procurement details, and what is the operational plan for staffing and maintenance?

articles.title: Don’t Politicise Ngoshe Captives’ Negotiation, Ndume Tells Mediator
articles.summary: Senator Ali Ndume, has urged the mediator handling the Ngoshe captives’ case to liaise closely with security agencies and warned against politicising the negotiations.   Ndume, who represents Borno South, spoke amid ongoing efforts to secure the release of residents abducted by insurgents in Ngoshe, Gwoza LGA, as well as the rescue of six of […]
articles.hausa_translation: Jami'i Ali Ndume ya bukaci mai sulhanci ya daina siyasancin shawarwarin fuduwar bakin jiya a Ngoshe, kuma ya owoyi game da aiki tare da hukumar tsaro.

critical_questions: What specific examples or scriptural basis did Adeboye provide to support prioritizing financial stability, and does this align with traditional RCCG teachings on faith and provision?

articles.title: Falana Tasks Media On Unresolved Murder Cases
articles.summary: Human rights lawyer, Femi Falana, has urged the media to take a more active role in pushing for the reopening and resolution of unresolved murder cases across Nigeria.   Falana made the appeal on Saturday during an interactive session in Ikeja, Lagos, themed: “The Role of Media in Promoting People’s Rights, Accountability and Access to […]
articles.hausa_translation: Maɗaukaki mai karɓar hakkin bil-haɗi, Femi Falana, ya bukaci labaran da suke aiki su ɗauki ƙaƙƙarfan rawa wajen buɓuga da warwarewar shari'ar muguɗ da ba a warware ba a cikin Nigeria.

What is the documented track record of media campaigns actually leading to case reopenings or convictions in Nigeria's justice system?
Why is a human rights lawyer calling on media rather than directly criticizing the judiciary, police, or prosecuting agencies—cui bono from this framing?

articles.title: NGE, SERAP to Tinubu Govt, governors, others: Protect journalists, end insecurity, impunity now
articles.summary: As the international community marks World Press Freedom Day, the Socio-Economic Rights and Accountability Project (SERAP) and the Nigerian Guild of Editors (NGE) have called on “the government of President Bola Tinubu, Nigeria’s state governors, and the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory to urgently ensure press freedom, protect journalists, and bring an end to the escalating insecurity an
articles.hausa_translation: NGE, SERAP ga Gwamnatin Tinubu, gwamnonin jihoye, da wasu: Karanta masu labari, kawo da rashin tsaro, karfi yanzu
critical_questions: What specific incidents of journalist attacks or censorship prompted this statement, and have SERAP/NGE documented these with evidence?

critical_questions: What are the specific kick-off and final dates mentioned, and why were these dates chosen over alternatives proposed by other potential host nations?
